Quick start

1. Start TaskBarHero and wait for "Game connected".
2. Configure synthesis rules under "Synthesis"; configure travel and corrosion under "Plaguelands".
3. "Corrode once" runs one batch with the current rules.
4. "Start all" runs map monitoring, statistics and configured automation.
5. Click "Stop all" or press F8 to stop.

The quality limit blocks items above your setting. Item names and original diagnostic logs follow the game language.
